asr.full_text: In this example I've done, you'll see how I used just 0.3 BNB to gain over 10.7 BNB in just minutes. Before you get started, you need to make sure you have the Metamask wallet installed on your internet browser. If you already have MetaMask set up, you can skip ahead to the next chapter of the video. Metam Mask is a secure browser wallet that enables you to transact with websites and use your BNB or ETH. Go to the Meta Mask official website. Be careful to enter the URL carefully, click download now, choose your browser, in this case it will be Chrome. Follow the simple instructions to create a new wallet if you do not have one already it will ask you to save your recovery phrase and create a password the metamask wallet comes with the ethereum network so we need to add the binance smart chain network so that we can work with bnb click here and go to add network We can now look at the other products on the right. Click here on the right and right click in the list. This is the list of the products we want to buy in the first place. First, we will download the payment of interest and transfer information into the BNB system. Click on this link to make a change and apply it to the main application. We now click here to enter the transfer information. Once you are done all that, click Save and the Binance Smart Chain network will be active on your wallet and you can change between the networks up here. You can now copy the wallet address or view the QR code to send your wallet the BNB coins required. You can also use this wallet address to withdraw from any exchange like Binance. Once you have that set up, you can start the flash loan arbitration process. The first thing you want to do is go to remix.ethereum.org this is where we program contracts for both the Etherium and Binance network on the left hand side click on Contracts and then click this button for new file name the file something like FlashLoan.sol Sol now you want to paste in the smart contract code into this new file. I'll put the newest, updated code in the video description. Make sure you copy the entire file. Next, on the left-hand menu, go over to the second tab and pick the compiler that matches the top of the code. Then, go down and click compile. Once that's done, go over to the third tab on the left. Then over here under Environment we want to click on Injeted Web 3 This will connect your MetaMask Browser Wallet if it isn't connected already so that you can interact with the contract. After you are connected click on the arrow beside deploy. Here you are going to enter the information for the brand new token you want to create. Enter a name, Symbol up to six letters and then the loan amount. This can be any amount from 1,000 and up. The higher initial deposit will have to be placed, but the higher the potential profit reward. Once you click Transact, you'll get a pop-up asking for the Gas Fees to create your new token contract, confirm in your wallet and then wait for the transaction confirmation. Once that is done, you're going to want to go over to the newly created contract on the left-hand side here and click to copy the contract address. You're now going to add liquidity to make your new token have a value you can actually trade against. Go to your wallet and click send. Copy and paste the new contract code in here then Then, choose the amount of liquidity you want to place. Normally, it needs to be a minimum of 0.15 for there to be sufficient fees to make all the transfers. Use a ratio of 0.15 for every 1,000 you've borrowed in the loan amount. The higher the liquidity the higher the return on investment Here I will choose zero point BnB Set up your deposit and then click to confirm Wait for network confirmation Now that your contract is created and we have some liquidity in Pancakeswap to provide value, we are going to execute the Flash Loan Attack. Go down here and click on the arrow next to your contract and click the red button to execute your flash loan. A final small amount of GAS fees to be paid for the action. Go ahead and confirm that. After your network confirmation, it may take a few minutes to receive the return, if everything was done correctly Let's go ahead and wait now and see what happens And there it is, over 10 BNB in only a few minutes Now remember, the return is different every time depending on the network volume and the amount of liquidity you put in. Sometimes you will get a small amount, while other times you can hit it big like we did here. We went from around the one BNB to over ten BNB. If it doesn't work or you don't get a large profit, try depositing a different amount of liquidity in your contract and then executing the loan again. Or starting from the very beginning to ensure you did everything correctly. So, that's it! The contract code and everything will be in the description.
